summary.headline: Astrological Chapters and Stellar Configurations
summary.text: Catalog entry for Hephaestion and folios 162–180v of a Venetian codex, listing excerpts on fortune and misfortune, action and glory, universal beginnings, ingresses, stellar configurations, local distinctions, angles, the Dog’s rising, and the natures and triplicities of the signs. Authorities and cross-references include Hephaestion of Thebes, Valens, Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, Dorotheus, Orpheus, Anubio, and Paris 2506.
